mechanism_of_action: Monoclonal antibody that binds beta-klotho and selectively activates the FGFR1c/beta-klotho co-receptor complex.
primary_endpoint: MASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis by histology at Week 52.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 24, relative liver fat content reductions versus placebo were 19.1% with 50 mg, 19.0% with 100 mg, and 26.1% with 300 mg. Interim differences from placebo were deemed insufficient to continue the trial.
safety_signal: MK-3655 was generally well tolerated; no specific adverse events or rates were reported.
